qemu_cmdline: qemu-system-aarch64 -machine virt,gic-version=3 -cpu host -enable-kvm -smp 2 -m 1G -drive file=/home/<user>/output/disk-qemu,if=none,id=drv0,format=raw -device virtio-blk-device,drive=drv0 -snapshot -netdev tap,id=n0,ifname=tap-qnx,script=no,downscript=no -device virtio-net-device,netdev=n0,mac=52:54:00:11:11:11 -object rng-random,filename=/dev/urandom,id=rng0 -device virtio-rng-device,rng=rng0 -kernel /home/<user>/output/ifs-demo2.bin -nographic

pin.loads: cpuload pinned per thread and read back; fma unpinned (host thread measured <=1% CPU)

probe_priority: SCHED_FIFO 50 in cpu6_prio only; reported by the probe itself in every arm file and checked by the gate
load_policy: started, verified alive after 3 s and at probe end, stopped at probe end; ceiling 27s
order: Williams over the six loaded arms (period 6); idle first and idle2 last every round
gpu_footprint: fma host thread measured at <=1% CPU (it blocks in cudaDeviceSynchronize); gpu_cpu6 vs cpu6 is close to matched
sampler: root tegrastats (per-core CPU, EMC_FREQ, GR3D) + EMC rate (bpmp and ccf debugfs) + GPU devfreq, every 500 ms nominal across each probe window; at least half that rate required per window
